ground_truth.title: Healthy Air fryer Recipes
ground_truth.main_content:
Healthy Air fryer Recipes

Quick and healthy air fryer recipes- everything from air fryer breakfast to snacks to healthy air fryer dinners!

We love our air fryer and how it makes everything crispy and delicious in record time with little to no oil.

Healthy Air Fryer French Toast Sticks are a kid friendly, crowd pleasing breakfast. Veggies in the air fryer are next level - I love this Air Fryer Zucchini and Air Fryer Brussels Sprouts with Hot Honey.

For meal prep, I love making Air Fryer Turkey Bacon and Air Fryer Hard Boiled Eggs. And don't miss a reader favorite: Air Fryer Chicken Thighs! They are so juicy and flavorful and sooo simple!

Still looking for an air fryer? Check out my recs in this post: Which Air Fryer Should You Buy?
